Testing prime values of \(a\):

- \(a=2\):  
  \(b=6(2)+1=13\) (prime),  
  \(c=20(2)+3=43\) (prime).  
  Then \(n=2\cdot 13\cdot 43=1118<10000\).

- \(a=3\): \(c=63\), not prime.

- \(a\ge 5\): \(n\ge 5\cdot 31\cdot 103=15965>10000\), so no larger prime works.

Thus the only valid value is \(\boxed{1118}\).
